invariants.rationale: The method is expected to process a list of input pairs; a null value may indicate a caller error.
A reduction function is required for the reduceByKey operation; it must not be null.
Parallelism should be a positive integer to enable parallel processing.
The method implies mapping over pairs, hence pairs in the list should not be null.
Keys are used for grouping in reduceByKey, so keys should not be null.
